dvWindowNote.message: Your computer will ask you to confirm it's you. The request may say “chrome-extension”: that is Sixkey.

dvFailed.message: That didn't work. Use your master password.

dvDue.message: Sixkey asks for the master password every 14 days, so that you don't forget it.

dvPaused.message: Keys replaced: $1 is paused until you turn it back on in Settings.

dvWaiting.message: $1 needs the master password once after a browser restart, and every 12 hours.

dvLead.message: Open Sixkey with $1 instead of typing the master password.

dvNone.message: This computer's sign-in cannot be used here. The PIN still works.

dvPick.message: In Chrome's dialog, iCloud Keychain or Google Password Manager (box ticked) work after restarts too; “This device only” until the browser closes.

dvOptIn.message: Allow a passkey that syncs to Apple, Google or your password manager

dvOptInNotice.message: It is then kept in that company's cloud and on your other devices. Anyone who gets into that account and also has a copy of this browser profile could open Sixkey without your master password. If unsure, leave it off: $1 still works until the browser closes.

dvRowPrf.message: Also after a restart. A copy of this browser profile still needs your master password.

dvRowPrfSynced.message: Also after a restart. Synced: that account plus a copy of this browser profile can open Sixkey too.

dvRowGate.message: Until the browser closes. It stops people at your computer, not programs on it or anyone who opens the browser's developer tools.

dvRowGateShared.message: Not used in this security mode.

dvNotWorking.message: Not working here, or lost this computer? Remove it: your master password and recovery key still open Sixkey.

dvKeyChanged.message: Keys replaced: turn $1 back on with one touch, no password.

dvSyncedRefused.message: This passkey syncs, so it works only until the browser closes. For restarts too, choose “Also after a restart” beside it.

dvNoPrf.message: This passkey has no key of its own for Sixkey: it works until the browser closes.

dvRemoved.message: Removed. The passkey itself is still in $1: delete it there if you no longer need it.

dvRefused.message: Sixkey cannot use this passkey; nothing was saved.
